backend/main.mo: Main backend actor that includes the MixinStorage module for blob storage functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the addition of four custom branded images to the AboutPage 'What Makes Us Special' section, with high confidence and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including styling, components, pages, routing, and asset management with focus on performance, SEO, and brand identity.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_HTTPS.md: Guide for configuring HTTPS/TLS on Internet Computer using custom domains with automatic Let's Encrypt certificate provisioning via boundary nodes.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SECURITY_HEADERS.md: Documentation for recommended security headers (HSTS, CSP, etc.) to enhance application security beyond IC's built-in HTTPS support.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme tokens for warm amber/teal brand palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect script, and preload hints for critical hero and menu images.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component with TanStack Router setup, layout wrapper (header, directions bar, watermark, footer), and lazy-loaded route-level code splitting for all pages.
frontend/src/components/BrandLogo.tsx: Reusable brand logo component with size variants, error handling, and text-based fallback displaying 'T&T' initials.
frontend/src/components/CustomerReviewsS: Customer reviews section displaying three review cards with star ratings and a link to view more reviews on Google.
frontend/src/components/GalleryImage.tsx: Gallery image component with loading states, error handling, hover effects, and fallback UI displaying an 'Image unavailable' message.
frontend/src/components/GetDirectionsBar: Sticky bar below header with location info and 'Get Directions' button linking to Google Maps for the restaurant location.
frontend/src/components/HeaderSearch.tsx: Search input component with submit handler used in site header for navigating to search results.
frontend/src/components/LogoMotif.tsx: Renders a logo image with size variants (sm/md/lg) and fallback to text-based 'T&T' brand mark if image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/MenuCategoryCaro: Displays menu categories in a carousel with keyboard/swipe navigation, showing category details and items with prices.
frontend/src/components/MenuScreenshotGa: Displays menu screenshot images with loading states and error fallbacks for failed image loads.
frontend/src/components/Section.tsx: Reusable section wrapper component with responsive padding and container styling.
frontend/src/components/Seo.tsx: Manages document head meta tags (title, description, OG tags, canonical URL) dynamically based on props, ensuring HTTPS URLs for production.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Site footer with brand info, social links, navigation, contact details, hours, and legal links in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Sticky header with logo, desktop/mobile navigation, search, and CTAs for ordering online and booking tables.
frontend/src/components/WatermarkBackgro: Renders layered, low-opacity background watermark images with deferred loading for visual depth.
frontend/src/data/customerReviews.ts: Static customer review data with name, rating, and text, plus Google Reviews URL constant.
frontend/src/data/menuData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and exports a comprehensive menu data structure with categories like shakes, juices, salads, soups, and various cuisines with items, prices, and descriptions.
frontend/src/draft24-exclusions.md: Documents the Draft 24 restoration process, listing excluded changes from Drafts 19, 23, and 25, and describing the included features like Gallery page, routing, design system, and responsive UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor using Internet Identity, with automatic query invalidation when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHorizontalSwipe.ts: Custom React hook that detects horizontal touch swipe gestures on an element with configurable left/right handlers and thresholds for swipe distance and vertical tolerance.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for React Query hooks related to backend functionality, currently empty with a note that the backend has no methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global CSS with Tailwind imports, custom OKLCH color tokens for light/dark themes using warm amber/teal/wood palette, and typography settings with Playfair Display and Inter fonts.
frontend/src/lib/bookingLinks.ts: Exports a single constant BOOKING_URL pointing to the Zomato table booking page for Taste Tales restaurant.
frontend/src/lib/brandAssets.ts: Centralized constants for all brand assets including logo, favicon, hero images, watermark tiles, gallery images, and value proposition images with optimized dimensions.
frontend/src/lib/directions.ts: Exports a single constant DIRECTIONS_URL containing the Google Maps directions link to Taste Tales restaurant location.
frontend/src/lib/globalSearchContent.ts: Implements global search functionality across menu items, offers, and pages with text normalization and keyword matching. Returns structured SearchResult objects with type, title, description, link, and optional category/badge fields.
frontend/src/lib/menuPdf.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for future PDF menu generation functionality.
frontend/src/lib/menuPrice.ts: Utility function to format menu item prices, handling numeric prices (with ₹ symbol), text labels (e.g., 'M.R.P.'), and fallback to 'Price on request'.
frontend/src/lib/menuScreenshotAssets.ts: Exports a deterministic ordered array of 18 optimized menu screenshot URLs (900x1600) for consistent menu page viewing across deployments.
frontend/src/lib/orderOnlineLinks.ts: Single source of truth for restaurant's online ordering URLs (Zomato and Swiggy) to ensure consistent links across all CTAs.
frontend/src/lib/socialLinks.ts: Centralized configuration object containing social media links for Instagram, Facebook, and Google reviews.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient provider for data fetching and InternetIdentity provider for authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component showcasing restaurant story, core values (global cuisines, quality ingredients, hygiene, family-friendly), with SEO optimization and structured content sections using cards and badges.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Contact page displaying restaurant location near GIFT City, phone number, hours, social links, and quick action buttons for directions, calls, and online ordering with SEO metadata.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Empty file, placeholder for future gallery page implementation.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main landing page with hero section featuring responsive images, cuisine highlights, family-friendly features, CTAs for booking and online ordering, and customer reviews section with comprehensive SEO.
frontend/src/pages/MenuPage.tsx: Menu page component with search functionality, displays menu categories in a carousel, and includes a hero section with CTA for ordering online via Zomato.
frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx: Offers page displaying three promotional deals (15% pre-book, 10% instant discount, bank/RuPay offers) with terms and conditions section.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Global search page that searches across menu items, offers, and pages, displaying categorized results with a search form and empty state handling.
frontend/src/types/pdf-lib-global.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file for pdf-lib global types.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended typography, animations, and brand-specific design tokens including warm shadows.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for 'Taste and Tales' restaurant website, documenting feature requests to add branded images to the About page's 'What Makes Us Special' section.
